decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of the firm’s core authentication and secure communication stack, it preserves option value in a growing market and its strategic fit is stronger than the limited website prominence suggests.
Its dedicated product page and close link to the firm’s cryptography and end-to-end security capabilities indicate enough traction and strategic importance to justify keeping it open.

Although hardware-based signature tokens are costlier and more niche than pure software offers, they still fit regulated security use cases and remain worth keeping while demand uncertainty is not fully resolved.

The product extends the firm’s compliance-oriented security offering into payments, and in an expanding industry a medium-sized R&D-active firm would usually retain such a complementary option unless performance clearly disappoints.
